title: Resume Session — should its popup match?

steps.headline: Should Resume Session use the matching popup header and list edge?
steps.hint: Compare the title and divider, then scroll each list to the end and back. The transcript is unchanged.
steps.risk: This is the real Resume browser with sample conversations. The proposed styling is review-only; the desktop preview's transcript and actions are not changing.
